steps.title: Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Use the public hostname that sites embed the tracker from. For a name that is not public, switch Let's Encrypt off.

steps.title: Reverse proxy
steps.subtitle: Point BunkerWeb at Umami's container; in Umami set CLIENT_IP_HEADER=X-Real-IP and SKIP_LOCATION_HEADERS=1.

steps.title: Methods and request rate
steps.subtitle: Allow the cross-origin preflight and dashboard deletes; let the dashboard load without throttling.

steps.title: Security - Login attempts
steps.subtitle: Five login tries per minute per IP. If many admins share one IP, enter 2r/s in the rate field, BunkerWeb's default.

steps.title: Security - Ban counting
steps.subtitle: Keep 400 out of the ban count so a stale tracker id bans nobody; whitelist any IP in Umami's IGNORE_IP.

steps.title: Security - Review tracker, dashboard and password CRS exclusions
steps.subtitle: Skip injection rules for what visitors' pages send, what the dashboard filters by and passwords.
